limitations: Source-correspondence review only; all selected and alternate relative packets retained unchanged.

patient_identity.statement: The elder brother is male and was diagnosed at 21; the packet uses 21 as last encounter, which the article does not explicitly establish.
limitations: Age at diagnosis/dialysis is not a documented age at last encounter.

genotype.statement: The source reports heterozygous UMOD c.688T>C, p.Trp230Arg in the index, elder brother and father.

segregation.statement: The same heterozygous change occurs in all three affected males across father and sons, supporting the reported autosomal dominant segregation.
limitations: Mother is shown unaffected in the pedigree, but her molecular testing and other relatives are not reported.

phase.statement: This packet contains one heterozygous UMOD allele; cis/trans phasing between two candidate alleles is inapplicable. No independent molecular phasing experiment is claimed.

causal_confidence.statement: Authors associate the rare variant with familial juvenile hyperuricemic nephropathy using phenotype, familial cosegregation, conservation and a prior family. This is source support, not a new pathogenicity classification.
limitations: Small family; absence in 200 controls is reported as personal communication; prediction and discussion are not a functional assay in these patients.

phenotype_completeness.statement: Packet is a selected feature summary. The paper additionally reports hypouricosuria/clearance, renal imaging and treatment response; onset and encounter dates must not be conflated.
limitations: The source does not give systematic longitudinal onset assessment or all normal findings for every relative.

assessment.statement: Heterozygous c.688T>C and p.Trp230Arg match the source. The packet additionally supplies NM_003361.4/NP_003352.2 and GRCh38 chr16:20348613 A>G; these accession/version and genomic-coordinate conversions are not independently established by this paper.
limitations: Protein/coding correspondence reviewed; exact transcript-version and genomic-assembly mapping not reported in source.

assessment.statement: Brother has serum creatinine 1.25 mg/dL and documented renal impairment; age 21 is diagnosis age, not a proven first biochemical onset.
limitations: Diagnosis/presentation age or clinical stage is less specific than the packet assertion; no exact onset or formal staging series is supplied.
